meta.title: Owner Notifications — triggers → fan-out → inbox
meta.subtitle: Owner-facing in-product signals (distinct from ops alerts): deduped and addressed to the people who can act (doc 16)

cards.title: Triggers (emit points)
items: drift — on a WORSE state transition only (none→watch, watch→regressed), not every eval
eval_failed — on verdict=fail (critical, with reason + failing cases); budget_threshold — spend crosses 80% / 90% of cap
model_deprecated — detector worker when a published version's pinned model goes deprecated/retired
approval_requested — a tool_approval pause; recipients OVERRIDE to publishers + admins (not the owner)

cards.title: Dedupe
items: A partial-unique index on OPEN rows (read_at IS NULL) collapses repeat signals into one
Marking read releases the key, so a recurrence can reopen it
Severity (info/warning/critical) is independent of kind — the emitter sets it

cards.title: Recipients (fan-out)
items: Default: the agent owner (agents.owner_subject — hard dependency on doc 14 for a routable subject)
owner floor (always) + fan-out to publishers + admins via the group_members projection cache (18 §4)
One event fans to N notification rows (one per recipient, same dedupe_key)
Scoped by RLS (workspace) AND by recipient_subject = the signed-in principal

cards.title: Owner notifications ≠ ops alerts
items: Audience: owner + publishers/admins, vs on-call operators (Alertmanager, doc 10 §5)
Channel: in-product bell + inbox (+ toast for critical), vs a page / Slack
Store: notifications (Postgres), vs Prometheus — spend appears on both on purpose
